title: Plan AH: AI Marketing Copy Matrix
summary: Selling points → core copy → multi-channel variants → compliance check → A/B test
scenario: For brands and operators rolling out one product across multiple channels — build once, reuse everywhere.

steps.title: Distill selling points
steps.detail: Use a 'pain → solution → proof' template to extract 3-5 core selling points, each backed by one piece of evidence. Have the model play the target user and ask 'so what?' five times to force out real value.
steps.tips: Phrase benefits as 'what the user gains' not 'what the product has'.

steps.title: Core copy
steps.detail: Write master copy for each selling point — headline, subhead, body and CTA — in one consistent voice. This is the master version every channel variant derives from.
steps.tips: Draft three headlines (rational / emotional / urgent) and have peers or AI score them.

steps.title: Multi-channel variants
steps.detail: Derive variants from the master: short social posts, email subject lines, ad hooks, product page paragraphs — mind each platform's character limits. Use each tool's built-in channel templates and swap in platform hot keywords.
steps.tips: Give each platform one exclusive hook (e.g. topic hashtags for Xiaohongshu).

steps.title: Compliance check
steps.detail: Flag superlatives (best, first, cures), unproven claims and platform-banned words; health and finance content is especially strict. Have the model list potential compliance risks, then review by hand.
steps.tips: Feed the model a banned-words list and ask it to tag every occurrence.

steps.title: A/B testing
steps.detail: Run 2-4 variants on the same budget, changing exactly one variable (headline or CTA). After enough samples, have the model analyze what worked and why, then iterate.
steps.tips: Test one variable per round — change two and you'll never know which one won.

pitfalls.title: Selling features, not benefits
pitfalls.detail: 'Added X' loses to 'saves you Y'; lead with user outcomes.

pitfalls.title: Copy-pasting across channels
pitfalls.detail: Context and length differ; verbatim reuse tanks conversion — always adapt.

pitfalls.title: Skipping compliance
pitfalls.detail: Superlatives and overclaims get copy pulled or fined; be extra careful in health and finance.

pitfalls.title: Testing without control
pitfalls.detail: A/B tests with multiple changes can't be attributed; one variable at a time.
